title: EBUS-guided TBNA for Molecular Diagnostic of Mediastinal Lymph Nodes (LN)
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to perform molecular diagnostic in mediastinal lymph nodes of non-small cell lung cancer patients sampled by endobronchial ultrasound guided finde needle aspiration (EBUS-TBNA).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥ 18 years
* Samples are collected before surgery or before any therapy
* ECOG 0 or 1
* Clinical stage I-II, T1-2, N0-1, M0)
* Surgically respectable
* Patient with enlarged med. lymphnodes (control group)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous RT/CHT
* Previous or current cancer of other entity
study_population: Patients with operable non-small cell lung cancer
